name: Hen xao
summary: The 16 Apr 2024 Da Nang page calls hến xào a Hội An specialty: clam meat soaked, boiled, and taken from the shell, then stir-fried with onion, scallion, and chili, finished with crushed roasted peanuts and eaten with crisp grilled rice paper.
origin: Hội An, on the 16 Apr 2024 city page. The same paragraph says the plate can still stop someone who has come to Da Nang. It does not give a Da Nang street.
taste: The page calls the clam sweet and salty, with chili, against the cracker.
howToEat: Eat the stir-fried clam with the crisp grilled rice paper. The page also describes bánh đập, the cracker clapped to a warm steamed sheet, as the partner on this plate.
where: Hội An. The 16 Apr 2024 page does not name a street or a shop. Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Hen xao — stir-fried clams in Hoi An
seoDescription: Hến xào is a Hội An plate on Da Nang’s 2024 food page: stir-fried clam, peanuts, and crisp rice paper. A street was not printed. Check on arrival.
